SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')) AS avg_amount,
    (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS avg_transactions_per_account;
SELECT
  AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS avg_per_account
FROM trans
WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS avg_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transaction_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS avg_transactions_per_account
FROM trans;
